figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: the chapter is one ladder of gaps - bands, junction, diode, transistor - climbed toward logic
figures.read: every device result is the gap, the mass-action law, the diode exponential, or a truth table

figures.title: The band gap is the whole device
figures.why: every device property is a gap value; conduction, the diode, LED colours all follow
figures.data: diamond 5.5 eV, Si 1.12, Ge 0.66, GaAs 1.42; kT ≈ 0.026 eV at 300 K
figures.read: a small gap means carriers jump at room temperature; a huge gap means none

figures.title: The p-n junction: diffusion, drift, and the potential hill
figures.why: the whole diode is one sentence - diffusion meets the drift it creates, at hill V0
figures.data: donors on n, acceptors on p, field n→p, V0 ≈ 0.7 V for Si
figures.read: no perpetual current flows; the hill is the diode's off state

figures.title: The diode equation: 60 mV per decade
figures.why: the knee and the decade rule are the same exponential read at two zooms
figures.data: I = I0(e^(V/VT) - 1), VT = 25.9 mV, a decade = 59.5 mV
figures.read: forward current multiplies by ten each extra 60 mV; the 0.7 V drop is where it meets resistance

figures.title: Intrinsic carriers: the half-gap is the temperature switch
figures.why: the exponent is half the gap, not the whole - why silicon conducts so much better when hot
figures.data: n_i ∝ T^(3/2) e^(-Eg/2kT); doubling T multiplies the exponential by ~5e4
figures.read: the steep curve is the half-gap exponential; the T^(3/2) prefactor is a rounding error

figures.title: Triage - route by the keyword
figures.why: the keyword names the route before any number is touched
figures.read: junction words to the hill, diode words to the decade ladder, gates to a truth table
